desc: Derive the two-layer graph transitions using original outgoing and incoming adjacency lists.
Verify that an even reversal parity uses original edge directions and odd parity uses reversed directions.
Implement Dijkstra with 64-bit distances, accounting for costs up to well beyond 32-bit range.
Analyze time and memory complexity for `N, M <= 2e5`.
Prepare robust stdin parsing and stdout output for the final Python solution.
